verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs describe an 'Ask Expensify AI Anything' assistant that can create/categorize/approve expenses, configure workspaces, and answer spend questions via plain language, directly matching the story of delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant. However, all evidence is vendor-authored marketing copy with no independent or hands-on verification of the AI assistant's actual behavior or reliability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the AI assistant works as described, details on scope/limits of delegation, and any user reviews specifically of the AI feature (existing community feedback concerns older SmartScan/categorization issues, not the AI assistant itself).
